entities.summary: Daniel Ernesto Flores is an American Catholic prelate who has served as bishop of Brownsville in Texas since 2009 and as Vice President of the United States Conference of Catholic Bishops since 2025. He served as an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of Detroit in Michigan from 2006 to 2009.
